comparison.objective: Place an apple in a bowl while avoiding an unmentioned loose glass, versus tune a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Hazard-aware motion planning and pick/place, not fine servicing or force-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: Apple reaches bowl while glass moves no more than 2 cm and is not tipped; apple-placement and glass-angle tolerances are missing.
comparison.reason: Tests unprompted obstacle preservation during transport, unrelated to damper commissioning.
